subject: Post-call: Stellarus performance validation & customer-led k6 run - next steps
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@stellarus.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarus.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync - targets / load test cadence

Thanks for the run-through today — helpful call. A couple of clarifications from our side to make sure the k6 run maps to our production-like profile:

- Latency targets: p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 700ms for single-token generation paths. For streaming responses we care about first-byte latency <= 120ms.
- Throughput/traffic: aiming for a sustained 80 req/s during business hours with 300 concurrent connections during peak. Burst to 600 concurrent for 5-minute spikes.
- Token mix: average response length ~ 140 tokens; top-end 800 tokens.
- Auth: we'll use the test API key you provide (rotate before/after test).

We can run the customer-led k6 next Wednesday 05/20 in the 10:00–13:00 PT window. Can you confirm the IP allowlist, test accounts, and a sandbox model alias we can hit? Also please share the k6 script you recommend — we'll run it from our CI runners and share the output.

Alex
Director of Engineering
Stellarus Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@stellarus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync - targets / load test cadence

Alex — great notes, thanks. Confirming we can support the test profile you described. Action items below and what we'll provide before your run: 

1) Sandbox endpoint + API key (scoped, rate-limited) — we will provision and send via secure link.
2) IP allowlist: please confirm the egress IPs you'll run from (CI runners), we will add to allowlist. If you need a temporary blanket range we can offer one for the scheduled window.
3) k6 script & example workload — attaching our recommended starter script (k6-script-stellarus-v1.js). It mirrors the call/stream patterns discussed (non-streamed single-shot and stream-enabled variants).
4) Test accounts CSV — we will create 25 test accounts with a mix of short/long prompt vectors and send test-accounts-stellarus.csv.
5) SLO matrix and pass/fail thresholds — attaching SLO-matrix-stellarus.xlsx with pass criteria (p95/p99/first-byte).

Proposed schedule: Wed 2026-05-20 10:00–13:00 PT (we'll have Marcus and Monica on deck to monitor). Please confirm and share your CI egress IPs and preferred test ramp profile (steady/sawtooth/step).

Couple of reminders: run artillery from multiple zones will more closely match your production mixing; if you want to do cross-region bursts we can temporarily enable extra capacity.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarus.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@stellarus.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync - targets / load test cadence

Jordan — thanks. CI egress IPs below (we'll run from two GitHub Actions self-hosted runners):
- 34.201.12.45
- 34.201.12.46
- 34.201.12.47

Ramp preference: start at 20 req/s for 10 minutes, step to 80 req/s over 20 minutes, hold for 60 minutes, then add two 5-minute bursts to 300 req/s. We'll run the stream and non-stream scenarios separately (30min each).

One question: will the sandbox model mirror your quantized runtime we discussed (int8-ish) or be full float? We want the results to reflect the Dedicated instance profile.

Thanks — Priya
Senior SRE, Stellarus
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@stellarus.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@stellarus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync - targets / load test cadence

Thanks Priya — all set on our side. Summary of confirmations and what you'll receive by EOD Monday (05/18):

- IP allowlist updated to include the three CI IPs you provided (34.201.12.45/46/47). File attached: allowlist-ips-stellarus.txt.
- Sandbox API key + scoped endpoint will be shared via secure Doc link (expires 48h).
- k6 starter script attached (k6-script-stellarus-v1.js). It includes an environment flag to toggle streaming vs non-streaming test mode.
- Test accounts CSV attached (test-accounts-stellarus.csv) with 25 synthetic users and prompt vectors.
- SLO pass/fail matrix attached (SLO-matrix-stellarus.xlsx).

On the runtime flavor: the sandbox will be configured to the Dedicated-like quantized profile (approximate int8 perf) so numbers should be representative of your target environment. We'll label the endpoint with the model alias: redwood/dedicated-stellarus-v1.

Monitoring plan: Marcus will run the trace collection and expose a temporary dashboard (token-level cost breakdown, tail latency histograms). Monica will watch for errors and automatic fallback triggers. If you hit any blocking regressions we'll coordinate an immediate roll-back to a higher-capacity variant.

Please confirm the 05/20 10:00–13:00 PT window and we'll mark our on-call rotation.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
